goal: Stop normal Career OS pursuit of roles with a reliable employer posting age of 22 days or more, while preserving the existing 0-7, 8-14, 15-21 bands and UNKNOWN recency semantics.
acceptance_conditions: a reliable employer posting age of 22 days or more is suppressed from normal Bora-facing serious discovery and package generation
a role at 22+ days may only proceed when Bora explicitly overrides the recency cutoff for that specific role
UNKNOWN or unpublished posting age remains UNKNOWN_WINDOW and is not treated as 22+ merely because the date is missing
posting age remains Pursuit Truth only and does not change Qualification Truth, Employer Truth, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, authorization, actionability, start-horizon, or package doctrine
PCG Apprentice Business Analyst JR102087 at 29 days is recorded as the motivating live example: good fit and submitted historically, but a comparable future normal run would suppress it on recency
fresh chats inherit the cutoff through .cursor/rules/role-selection.mdc
stop_conditions: implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths
implementation changes the 0-7, 8-14, or 15-21 band boundaries
implementation turns UNKNOWN_WINDOW into a stale/old classification
implementation changes qualification, actionability, start-horizon, resume, cover-letter, package-output, or runtime/schema behavior
